description.value: This BC Liquor Store is part of the provincial government's chain of 198 BCLIQUOR retail locations operated by the Liquor Distribution Branch across British Columbia. Located on Main Street in Oliver — the self-described Wine Capital of Canada — it offers wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. A practical resupply stop for touring cyclists riding through the Okanagan wine country.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate BCLIQUOR retail store in Oliver, BC (page title: 'OLIVER - Store Hours & Location | BCLIQUOR'), consistent with the OSM record. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null. The store is confirmed real and open based on an active, rendering website and looks_closed=false.
